summary.storyTitle: Story 3: The Adapter and the Seven Prompts
summary.implementedScope: Implemented the Story 3 adapter pipeline behind the unchanged Epic 02 seam: each operation now bounds input where DD-7 applies (summarizeToolResult head+tail+marker under maxInputChars), renders its kind's prompt, calls the host ModelCall, rejects empty/whitespace-only success text as retryable empty_output, and returns trimmed text with config-stamped provenance. Ported the POC's settled smoothing prompt verbatim into smoothing-v1 (the other six templates remain marked pre-dial-in with golden coverage). Handlers copy result.provenance into DerivedFormMetadata at all five form-write sites (messages landForm; turns rendering/projection/chunk-summary); the deterministic provider sets none, so its forms carry none. Wrote prompt goldens for all seven templates plus the two story suites covering TC-2.1, TC-2.2, and TC-2.3, demonstrated red on the new behaviors before implementing, and recorded the new Red files in the immutability manifest.
summary.acceptanceRationale: Story-lead is pausing for caller ruling 03-the-adapter-and-the-seven-prompts-story-run-001-ruling-spec-deviation before impl-lead can accept the story.

evidence: 005-verify.json marks SV-03-001 resolved and reports no open findings.

specDeviations.description: Retryable failure reasons are formatted `provider_failure: <kind>: <message>` rather than DD-3's literal 'reason is the kind string itself'. The Epic 02 queue copies the provider's reason verbatim onto exhausted forms (failTerminal sets form.reason and metadata.lastError from one string), and immutable Epic 02 tests pin that verbatim copy — so TC-2.3's required exhaustion shape ('reason provider_failure and last error naming empty_output') is only reachable if the adapter authors retryable reasons with the provider_failure code leading, matching the reason-code-before-first-colon convention Epic 02 established. Terminal kinds (auth, invalid_request) stay kind-led and land failed immediately, per the tech design's Error Contract. Story 4's classification tests (TC-3.1 asserts the same exhaustion shape for network) should consume this format.
specDeviations.reasoning: Story implementor surfaced this spec deviation during bounded child execution.

changedFiles.reason: Five-step operation pipeline: tool-result input bounding (DD-7), empty/whitespace-only success classified empty_output retryable (AC-2.4), output shaping via trim, classified failure reasons (retryable reasons lead with the provider_failure code, kind named next), provenance stamped from assignment config (AC-2.5)
Replaced the pre-dial-in placeholder with the POC's settled smoothing system prompt, ported verbatim (AC-2.3)
landForm takes ProviderResult and copies result.provenance into form metadata alongside the existing mechanical stamps (DD-4, AC-2.5)
One-line provenance copy on each of the three turn-owned form writes: turn_rendering (merged with receipts metadata), lower_band_projection, and chunk summaries (DD-4, AC-2.5)

TC-2.1 and TC-2.3: seven kinds ready with canned content and assignment provenance, record-authored outcomes/receipts disagreeing with adversarial canned text, handler equivalence under the deterministic provider with no provenance, empty-output retry/exhaustion/shaping legs

TC-2.2: per-template goldens with fixture embedding and single-turn shape, registry completeness, brief receipt-stripping proven through the adapter against a detailed-lane contrast, tool-result bounding through the adapter operation
Golden pinning the POC-settled smoothing rendering
Golden pinning chunk-detailed-v1 rendering including the receipts section
Golden pinning chunk-brief-v1 rendering including the outcomes-only section
Recorded the story's Red-phase test files and goldens for the immutability guard

rulings.rationale: Approved: formatting retryable failure reasons as 'provider_failure: <kind>: <message>' is the only shape that satisfies both TC-2.3's required exhaustion form (reason provider_failure, last error naming empty_output) and the immutable Epic 02 verbatim-copy contract (failTerminal copies the provider reason string as-is). Terminal kinds remain kind-led per the Error Contract. Story 4's TC-3.1 exhaustion assertions must consume this same format — noted for Story 4 verification.
